title: Finite amplification for a proper square
statement: For a chosen Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with all four schemes Noetherian of finite dimension, both vertical maps proper, an adic coefficient datum d [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and a positive integer N killing A/I and invertible at every stalk of all four schemes, assume every geometric fibre of f over every algebraically closed field has dimension at most e. Then [def-weil-pbc-finite-level-amplification] holds with bound 2e. This is only the finite coefficient assertion, with no witness or completed-tower conclusion.

proof.text: Evaluating N(A/I)=0 at 1 shows N in I; hence N^n kills A/I^n. The additive order of each quotient element divides N^n, so its stalk image is a divisor of a unit. Paste the chosen Cartesian square with the geometric-point pullback square: pullback(fprime,y) is isomorphic to pullback(f,y followed by g). Their dimensions agree by the induced homeomorphism, including empty fibres. Apply the given geometric bound directly over the same algebraically closed field; no local fibre-dimension theorem or supremum is needed.

At every positive quotient exponent apply the proper direct-image finiteness theorem twice with the coefficient-order and fibre bounds just proved. Apply bounded-constructible pullback preservation and its interval theorem to both horizontal maps. Package the resulting four clauses and the target conventions in Scheme.HasFiniteLevelAmplification, with common bound 2e.

theorem finiteLevelAmplification_of_isProper
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : Scheme.AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian X'] [IsNoetherian Y']
    (hDimX : ∃ k : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (k : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hDimY : ∃ k : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ (k : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hDimX' : ∃ k : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X' ≤ (k : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hDimY' : ∃ k : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim Y' ≤ (k : WithBot ℕ∞))
    [IsProper f] [IsProper f']
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hAnnihilator : ∀ a : A ⧸ d.ideal, N • a = 0)
    (hInvertX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (N : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hInvertY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (N : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (hInvertX' : ∀ x : X', IsUnit (N : X'.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hInvertY' : ∀ y : Y', IsUnit (N : Y'.presheaf.stalk y))
    (e : ℕ)
    (hFib : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y),
      topologicalKrullDim ↥(pullback f y) ≤ (e : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    Scheme.HasFiniteLevelAmplification sq d (2 * e)
